text:
I've watched their troop numbers vs ours for a long time. They have so many they could be a threat even if they came at you with rocks and sticks. Now they are doing the same with ships. They don't have to be great, just float long enough to do their deed.
It's not all about the number of ships in our Navy. You have to look at the big picture. Navy doesn't have the assets to move all the services equipment around in war or crisis, they rely on FSS Fast Sealift Ships of which most are commercial ships. And there aren't enough Merchant Marines to operate what's available now much less if we increase ship production. It's a quandary that's been going on for quite a while now. One of the reasons why we recently said we can't do two wars at once anymore.
